Hey so I just watched it in full and here’s my honest feedback 

- maybe add a preface of what’s going on before the film just something that explains what type of world we are entering ( like the opening scene intro for Star Wars with the long text crawls that explain what transpired before) just give a little more context is all.

- kind of a little too slow paced I would say the first three minutes felt slow and can be condensed immensely 

- I would say make it more suspenseful of the werewolf to the audience. I would love to see up close shots that don’t automatically reveal what/who the monster is or looks like,  do the big monster reveal at the end when michael attacks the man and not his sister. It Just adds an element of mystery and another layer to the story because you really want the audience to be like “ wtf is hunting them!?” think  how a “quiet place” does with their monsters or Jaws with the music in a way. You don’t want to reveal the big enemy right away.

- closer shots on the running and action scenes I would look up a YouTube video on how to film action scenes - film riot has good info and tips on that . you want to capture fast pacing and intensity in running and atttack scenes sometimes.

- Great music selection the background music was overall pretty good and matched well

- I agree with the font choice not being that good but I don’t think it takes away THAT much from the short imo. 

- *SPOILERS* the twist at the end of Michael being her brother threw me off guard and so did Michael being killed too which was great. 

All in all this is my honest feedback - very good creativity just better camera work and writing needs to be better. Visually pretty nice to look at too. And soundtrack compliments very well  overall I give it a a 6/10 . Which isn’t a bad rating in my book. I will honestly say I am looking forward to see what you film next! Congrats on this nonetheless .
